summary_en: 88,300 shares acquired in August 2026 for 178.6 million yen in open market purchases. Cumulative acquisitions through August 31 reached 229,000 shares for 447.3 million yen, against an approved program of up to 300,000 shares (1.18% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) and 500 million yen through September 30, 2026.
title_en: Notification on Open Market Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: SOFTCREATE HOLDINGS announced that it completed open market acquisitions of 88,300 treasury shares for 178.6 million yen during August 1–31, 2026, on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. This continues the buyback program authorized by the board on June 15, 2026. Through August 31, cumulative acquisitions totaled 229,000 shares (approximately 0.3% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for 447.3 million yen. The board-approved program permitted acquisitions of up to 300,000 shares (1.18% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for up to 500 million yen during the period from June 16 through September 30, 2026. As of the reporting date, the company had exhausted approximately 45% of the share count authorization and 89% of the yen amount authorization, with the program continuing through the end of September.
